## Personality

Allan is a frank and cheerful young man who holds high ideals, making him well-liked by people of all ages. He is a skilled preacher whose magnificent sermons are noted to improve continuously.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P3](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0003)_

## History

Mrs. Allan was a dreadful mischief as a young girl who frequently got into scrapes and struggled with geometry. She visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea with her husband, where she kindly comforted a mortified [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after the girl accidentally flavored a layer cake with liniment instead of vanilla, afterwards inviting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to show off her flower garden. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Allan and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) share a close, good friendship that begins during Allan's visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Despite an embarrassing incident where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally flavors Allan's tea cake with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla, Allan kindly comforts the mortified girl and invites her to show off her flower garden. Later, when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) passes away, Allan provides comfort to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as she processes her deep grief.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P35](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0035), +10 more_
